headlines.title: الأمم المتحدة: نحو 11.7 مليون امرأة وفتاة إضافية يواجهن خطر انعدام الأمن الغذائي
headlines.snippet: The United Nations reports that approximately 11.7 million additional women and girls face food insecurity. This underscores a growing global challenge.

headlines.title: Vessel struck by unknown projectile in Strait of Hormuz, UKMTO says
headlines.snippet: A vessel was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, causing a fire that was extinguished. All crew members were reported safe.

headlines.title: Syria, EU discuss new agreement, recovery and Israeli withdrawal
headlines.snippet: Syria and the EU discussed a new agreement, recovery efforts, and the withdrawal of Israeli forces. Syria called for the EU to demand Israeli withdrawal.

headlines.title: Saudi Arabia reaffirms support for Sudan’s stability, sovereignty
headlines.snippet: Saudi Arabia has reaffirmed its support for Sudan's stability and sovereignty. This commitment was expressed during a phone call with Abdel Fattah al-Burhan.

headlines.title: Syrian FM, EU foreign policy chief discuss ties, economic recovery and reconstruction
headlines.snippet: Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad Hassan al-Shaibani met with EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas to discuss bilateral relations, regional developments, and economic recovery.

headlines.title: Syria allows non-exclusive agencies for foreign vehicle and tire firms
headlines.snippet: Syria will permit foreign vehicle, machinery, and tire companies to establish non-exclusive agencies and open branches in the country.

headlines.title: Syria’s Muslim Brotherhood fights for its future
headlines.snippet: Syria's Muslim Brotherhood is re-evaluating its political future amidst regional pressure and internal divisions, facing questions about pluralism in the country's transition.

headlines.title: Syria is rising, al-Sharaa tells UN—but challenges remain at home
headlines.snippet: Syria's representative at the UN stated that the country is rising, but domestic challenges remain. The focus is on turning international acceptance into economic progress.

headlines.title: UAE says FlyDubai co-pilot attempted to carry out terrorist attack
headlines.snippet: The UAE stated that the Flydubai co-pilot attempted to carry out a terrorist attack. The incident is under investigation by aviation authorities.

headlines.title: Gargash says FlyDubai attack ‘terrorist act’ as he praises pilot
headlines.snippet: Gargash called the Flydubai attack a 'terrorist act' and praised the pilot for his bravery. The incident is being investigated as a serious security matter.

headlines.title: Tanker attacked in Strait of Hormuz: UK maritime agency
headlines.snippet: A tanker was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, according to the UK maritime agency. The incident raises concerns about shipping safety in the region.

headlines.title: Indian FlyDubai pilot Smit Machchhar praised for bravery during cockpit attack
headlines.snippet: Indian pilot Smit Machchhar of Flydubai has been praised for his bravery during the cockpit attack. He is being hailed as a hero.

headlines.title: Two Iranians charged with planning attack on Manchester Jews
headlines.snippet: Two Iranians have been charged in the UK with planning an attack on Jewish people in Manchester. This is part of a series of antisemitic incidents.

headlines.title: UAE says flydubai co-pilot attempted ‘terrorist act’ on Israel-bound flight
headlines.snippet: The UAE reported that the flydubai co-pilot attempted a 'terrorist act' on the flight bound for Israel. The investigation into the incident is ongoing.

headlines.title: Oil tankers attacked in Hormuz strait: UK maritime agency
headlines.snippet: Oil tankers were attacked in the Hormuz strait, as confirmed by the UK maritime agency. The incidents occurred in a critical global shipping route.

headlines.title: Five Indians rescued after tanker hit by projectile in Strait of Hormuz
headlines.snippet: Five Indian nationals were rescued after their tanker was hit by a projectile in the Strait of Hormuz. The vessel was damaged but continued its journey.

headlines.title: Hero flydubai pilot Capt. Smit Machchhar airlifted to UAE; Indian Ambassador visits him
headlines.snippet: Heroic Flydubai pilot Capt. Smit Machchhar was airlifted to the UAE, and the Indian Ambassador visited him. His actions during the attack are being recognized.

headlines.title: UAE orders investigation into flydubai Tel Aviv flight incident
headlines.snippet: The UAE has ordered an investigation into the flydubai Tel Aviv flight incident. Aviation authorities are looking into the details of what happened in the cockpit.

headlines.title: UAE says co-pilot attempted ‘terrorist act’ in Flydubai incident
headlines.snippet: The UAE stated that the co-pilot attempted a 'terrorist act' in the Flydubai incident, using a crash axe against the captain. An investigation is underway.

headlines.title: Israeli forces arrest 4 Palestinians, search homes in West Bank raids
headlines.snippet: Israeli forces arrested four Palestinians and searched homes during raids in the West Bank. This is part of ongoing security operations in the region.

headlines.title: Yemeni army carries out 71 operations against Houthi positions in country's southwest
headlines.snippet: The Yemeni army reported conducting 71 operations against Houthi positions in southwestern Yemen. These targeted gatherings and military buildups.

headlines.title: 1st Israeli flight departs Dubai to repatriate stranded passengers after Flydubai incident
headlines.snippet: An Arkia flight has departed Dubai to repatriate stranded passengers following the Flydubai incident. This occurs amid a temporary suspension of Flydubai flights.

headlines.title: ‘I was not going to let others die’: Flydubai pilot recounts cockpit attack
headlines.snippet: Flydubai pilot Smit Machchhar recounted the cockpit attack, stating he forced the door open despite injuries as the plane plunged. He was determined to prevent further harm.

headlines.title: King Charles to confront Britain’s slavery past during Caribbean tour
headlines.snippet: King Charles is set to confront Britain's past involvement in slavery during a Caribbean tour. This acknowledges historical injustices and calls for reconciliation.

headlines.title: Egypt's Sisi calls for peaceful solutions to Africa’s conflicts
headlines.snippet: Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi urged African nations to prioritize peaceful conflict resolution and strengthen state institutions. He emphasized respect for national sovereignty.

headlines.title: Philippines urges ASEAN talks after 50 killed in Myanmar airstrike
headlines.snippet: The Philippines has called for ASEAN talks following a deadly airstrike in Myanmar's Rakhine state. The country chairs ASEAN in 2026.

headlines.title: Christa Pike unconscious as Tennessee execution goes awry: Lawyers
headlines.snippet: Convicted killer Christa Pike was left unconscious and critically ill after a failed execution attempt in Tennessee. Her lawyers reported the incident.

headlines.title: India detains hundreds as voter-roll protests erupt in Delhi
headlines.snippet: India has detained hundreds of protesters in New Delhi amidst demonstrations against the chief election commissioner regarding voter-roll changes.

headlines.title: PHOTO Best restaurants in Istanbul, ranked
headlines.snippet: A jury of experts has ranked Istanbul's best restaurants for the "Pearly Gastronomy Guide." The guide highlights top culinary establishments.

headlines.snippet: The UAE's top prosecutor stated that the FlyDubai co-pilot attacked the captain with an 'axe' in an attempted 'terrorist' act. The investigation is ongoing.

headlines.title: Trump says co-pilot in flydubai incident may have been a 'terrorist' or 'whack-job'
headlines.snippet: Donald Trump suggested the co-pilot in the Flydubai incident might have been a 'terrorist' or a 'whack-job.' He commented on the potential motives.

headlines.snippet: An Arab party leader has agreed to withdraw from the Israeli election race following pressure from a court. This decision impacts the political landscape.

headlines.title: US is moving around 9,000 troops aboard ships to Middle East as Trump weighs new attacks on Iran
headlines.snippet: The US is deploying approximately 9,000 troops aboard ships to the Middle East as Donald Trump considers further actions against Iran.

headlines.title: Yemeni army says it launched six air strikes on Houthi positions in Taiz
headlines.snippet: The Yemeni army reported launching six air strikes targeting Houthi positions in Taiz. These operations are part of the ongoing conflict in Yemen.
